2609.31341.title: The Right Information Extraction Pipeline Depends on the Document: Accuracy-Energy Trade-offs for Small, Local Models
2609.31341.paper_summary: Whether an information extraction pipeline should process page images or parsed text depends on the document, and the answer flips across the layout spectrum. We study this trade-off under a constraint that rules out (closed) cloud services: privacy-sensitive documents processed on-premise by small ($\le 8\mathrm{B}$ parameter) text-only and vision--language models, evaluated on both accuracy and energy over a design space spanning input representation, model family, and inference configuration. Benchmarking on the near-plain-text Kleister-NDA contracts and the layout-rich VRDU forms, we find that batching is the dominant energy lever, cutting energy per page by 38-85% at no cost in accuracy, while FP8 quantization saves 27-32% when requests are served one at a time but less than 1mWh per page (9-19%) once batching is applied. Preprocessing dominates what remains: neural OCR costs $17\times$ more energy per page than classical OCR and never reaches the Pareto frontier. Which representation wins flips with the type of document: vision--language models on layout-rich documents and small text-only models with a cheap parser on near-plain text, where they are both more accurate and cheaper than any vision--language configuration. Our work yields concrete guidelines for energy-efficient, privacy-compliant local information extraction.
2609.31341.paper_summary_zh: 無論資訊提取管道應該處理頁面圖像還是解析過的文本，取決於文件，答案在佈局範圍內是變化的。<lb/>我們在排除（封閉）雲服務的限制下研究這一權衡：隱私敏感的文件由小型（$\le 8\mathrm{B}$ 參數）僅文本和視覺-語言模型在本地處理，並在設計空間中對準確性和能量進行評估，該空間涵蓋輸入表示、模型家族和推理配置。<lb/>在接近純文本的 Kleister-NDA 合同和佈局豐富的 VRDU 表單上進行基準測試，我們發現批處理是主要的能量杠杆，能夠在不損失準確性的情況下將每頁的能量減少 38-85%，而 FP8 量化在一次處理一個請求時節省 27-32%，但在應用批處理後每頁的能量消耗低於 1mWh（9-19%）。<lb/>預處理主導了剩餘的部分：神經 OCR 每頁的能量消耗是傳統 OCR 的 $17\times$，並且從未達到帕累托邊界。<lb/>哪種表示方式獲勝取決於文件的類型：在佈局豐富的文件上使用視覺-語言模型，而在接近純文本上使用便宜的解析器的小型僅文本模型，兩者的準確性和成本都優於任何視覺-語言配置。<lb/>我們的工作為能量高效且符合隱私要求的本地資訊提取提供了具體指導。
